name: smwgraphics-new-donut-blocks
title: New Donut Blocks
description:
These blocks try to represent the Donut Lift Blocks from newer Mario games, more specifically Super Mario 3D Land.

There are two options in the ZIP file:

Normal Donut Block
This folder contains the SMB3-ish Donut Block

Square Donut Block
And this folder contains the Square Donut Block, that tries to be similar to Super Mario 3D Land.

It's to be used with this block, and be sure to give credits to KesterTank and to Kopejo for them, ripped from this sheet!

I hope you like it!
